title: Cartan moving frames and discrete exterior calculus for self-supervised protein structure representation
citation_status: ScientistTwo gallery manuscript. The PDF header says the text is under review for ICLR 2025 and the authors are anonymous. Cite the gallery PDF. Do not cite it as an accepted ICLR paper.

firewall.frame_meaning: E_i is the residue frame in SO(3) built from backbone N, C-alpha, and C. This case leaves the dissertation's Lie-point symmetries and Saint-Venant-Exner systems on their own pages.

smoke.measures: synthetic helix, sheet, coil, and globule backbones of 60 to 90 residues
smoke.rule: Probe accuracy saturates on these four families. Integrated position RMSE is the endpoint that reads the transport mechanism.

paper.measures: TEDBench-train, 369740 structures; TEDBench test, 46218 structures; external CATH 4.4, 27638 structures; 965 CATH-T classes
paper.rule: The paper's scientific claim is the matched from-scratch delta against vanilla MAE. Absolute accuracy below the public MiAE-B row is the printed comparison, and it stays in the ledger.

equations.source: gallery PDF §3.1 and independent method notes
equations.statement: t_i = C-alpha_i. e1 = normalize(C_i - C-alpha_i), e2 = normalize((N_i - C-alpha_i) - ((N_i - C-alpha_i) · e1) e1), e3 = e1 × e2, E_i = [e1 e2 e3] in SO(3).
omega_ij = log(E_i^T E_j) in so(3). theta_i = E_i^T (t_j - t_i) is the local soldering form on a contact edge.
For a contact triangle f = (i, j, k), Omega_f = omega_ij + omega_jk + omega_ki + (1/2)[omega_ij, omega_jk] in so(3). In the rotation-vector representation the bracket is the cross product.

equations.source: gallery PDF equation (3) and independent method notes
equations.statement: Attention logits add W_conn * RBF(D_DEC(i, j)) and W_curv * Tr(Omega_i Omega_j^T). D_DEC(i, j) = ||(exp(-tau L_1))_ij||_F, with L_1 the normalised connection Laplacian.
E_hat_m = E_a exp(sum_{e in path(a -> m)} omega_hat_e). t_hat_m = t_a + sum_{e = (u, v) in path} E_hat_u theta_hat_e. The anchor a(m) is a visible residue.
L = L_theta + L_pos + L_rot + L_omega + L_Omega, summed on masked residues. The independent implementation also exposes a separate integration weight. A run names which list it trains.

locked_readings.statement: On the gallery fold-classification endpoint, contiguous span masking at mask ratio 0.50 is the strongest masking condition in Table 6. Hard holonomy top-k is the weakest holonomy variant. Soft holonomy sampling moves toward uniform masking as temperature rises and stays at or below that uniform limit.

In gallery Table 5, multi-hop MST integration has masked-residue C-alpha RMSD 2.61 angstrom and CATH top-1 41.95. K-shortest integration has RMSD 3.82 angstrom and CATH top-1 46.40. Lower reconstruction RMSD is a separate observation from higher transfer.

In gallery Table 3 the curvature-only attention bias changes top-1 by -0.33 on TEDBench and -2.15 on CATH relative to the no-bias encoder. The combined heat-plus-curvature bias changes top-1 by +5.75 and +6.33.

The from-scratch curvature-biased encoder in Table 1 prints 60.18 / 39.30 on TEDBench and 64.12 / 37.93 on CATH. The same table's public MiAE-B probe row prints 74.20 / 57.79 and 86.09 / 66.73. The matched delta against vanilla MAE is the paper claim.

On frame-exact coordinates the group holonomy of a closed frame loop is the identity, as recorded in gallery Appendix A and in the independent method notes. The operative defect used for masking and curvature features is the curvature energy built from Omega, which keeps the non-abelian bracket term.

open_readings.statement: Table 3 prints mean attention entropy 3.61 for the no-bias encoder and 3.04 for the combined bias. Section 4.3 says the no-bias encoder collapses to low entropy in deep layers and that the combined bias maintains 3.04 nats. A mechanism claim about collapse needs a per-layer entropy observation. Until that observation exists, the accuracy deltas in Table 3 stay quotation claims.

Section 3.2 defines a per-residue holonomy defect by summing ||H(gamma) - I||. Appendix A states that this group holonomy vanishes on frame-exact coordinates. Implementations use ||Omega_i|| as the defect score and say so in the method section.

Several printed deltas differ by 0.01 from the difference of the printed cells. CATH macro F1 for the DEC objective is printed as +11.03 while 34.94 - 23.90 = 11.04. The holonomy-masking CATH top-1 gain is printed as +13.36 while 64.45 - 51.10 = 13.35. MST versus 1-hop is printed as -3.12 while 41.95 - 45.08 = -3.13. K-shortest versus 1-hop is printed as +1.33 while 46.40 - 45.08 = 1.32. The 6 angstrom graph versus 8 angstrom is printed as -2.12 while 42.54 - 44.67 = -2.13. Quote the cell and the printed delta as separate observations.

Appendix A runs the component ablations for 10 epochs on 50K and 20K subsets. Table 1 uses 5 epochs on 369740 training structures. Absolute accuracies from Tables 4 to 6 stay inside their own protocol.

limitations.text: A vanilla masked backbone autoencoder supervises per-residue coordinate, rotation, and local-frame heads. The gap between direct position RMSE and integrated position RMSE on held-out chains is the observable of inconsistent transport.
limitations.test: Compare direct-position RMSE with integrated-position RMSE with and without the integration objective.

limitations.text: Equal weights across the Cartan terms let local reconstruction dominate the gradient that reaches the integrated endpoint.
limitations.test: Raise the integration and connection-form weights by 4 and compare integrated position RMSE with the equal-weight model.

limitations.text: Uniform span masking samples regions independently of curvature energy. This is a smoke-tier hypothesis. Gallery locked reading N1 already records that holonomy-targeted masking loses to contiguous spans on fold-classification transfer.
limitations.test: At smoke scale, compare geometry masking with span masking on integrated position RMSE. A smoke win on RMSE stays a smoke observation and leaves N1 in force on the paper endpoint.

limitations.text: Development chains have 60 to 90 residues. Length extrapolation and a second mask distribution are untested inside the smoke budget.
limitations.test: Run the two supplementary commands after a model is selected.

ideas.name: full Cartan-DEC self-supervision
ideas.risk: Geometry biases can be weak at smoke width. The transport losses remain the part this idea is entitled to claim.

ideas.name: transport-weighted training
ideas.risk: A 4x transport weight can raise local reconstruction error. Screening rejects that regression.

ideas.name: curvature-guided masking
ideas.risk: Gallery reading N1 says defect-guided masking loses on transfer. This idea may be run only as a smoke RMSE comparison, with N1 left locked.

evolved_ideas.name: curvature-stabilised transport
evolved_ideas.risk: Extra curvature weight can over-constrain coil regions. That shows up as a worse primary RMSE.

supplementary.question: Does the selected model keep its primary-metric gain on chains of 80 to 140 residues?
Does the selected gain remain under random masking at the same mask ratio?

integrity_checks.pass: Re-running the selected command reproduces every reported number in the manuscript.
Protected paths are unchanged and the run stayed inside its tier budget.
Every citation resolves to an entry in sources or to a reference checked in the run ledger.
The method section names the trained loss list, mask strategy, anchor path, and the holonomy convention from locked reading N5.
